summary.result: Soil moisture extraction and extraction pattern of cucumber crop calculated in this study can be utilized as a basic data for irrigation water management in protected cultivation.
summary.background: The study for analyzing soil moisture characteristics is necessary for adequate irrigation water and soil water management in protected cultivation.
